place: a Captain America costume at a fan convention

moments.what: the Marvel logo sticker sits over Captain America

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Marvel borrowed to make its own movies, and the security was Captain America.

moments.what: the page pushes to the line
the highlighter swipes chapter eleven, a stamp

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The decade before, Marvel had gone bankrupt.

place: two studios split down the middle

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Its biggest heroes were out on licence: Spider-Man at Sony, the X-Men at Fox. So how could it make its own films?

place: Merrill Lynch's tower in New York

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So Marvel took a $525M credit line, arranged by Merrill Lynch.

place: Marvel's annual report, the film facility page

moments.what: the page pushes to the line
an arrow to Captain America on the list
the arrow moves to the Avengers

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Its filing says the film rights to 10 characters were pledged as collateral, Captain America and the Avengers among them.

place: Doctor Strange at a comic con

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Black Panther and Doctor Strange were on the list too. So what would Marvel film first?

place: an Iron Man suit at a convention

moments.what: cut to the Iron Man suit, the date slams in
cut to Robert Downey Jr., a lower third
a stamp: PAID BY THE LOAN

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Its first film was Iron Man, starring Robert Downey Junior, and that same loan paid for it.

place: the Walt Disney Studios gate in Burbank

moments.what: cut to the Disney studio gate, the date slams in
cut to Bob Iger, a lower third

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Then Disney came, offering $30 a share in cash, plus stock, for more than 5,000 characters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: In all, Disney agreed to pay about $4B for the company that had pledged its own heroes.

place: stacks of comics at a fan expo
Captain America from the first frame

moments.what: back to Captain America from the first frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Iron Man or Captain America: which hero saved Marvel? Next time you see the Avengers, remember,
